title: Forget the Big Chipmakers for a Minute: This Overlooked AI Stock Is Up 114% and Just Landed Deals With Nvidia and Amazon
title_zh: 暂时忘掉大型芯片制造商：这家被忽视的 AI 股票上涨 114%，刚刚与 Nvidia 和亚马逊达成交易
summary: Investors chasing the AI trade through chipmakers may be overlooking the company that makes the fiber tying those chips together.
summary_zh: 通过芯片制造商追逐人工智能交易的投资者可能会忽视制造将这些芯片连接在一起的光纤的公司。

title: Apollo Wraps Up $35 Billion Chip Deal for Anthropic
title_zh: Apollo 为 Anthropic 完成 350 亿美元芯片交易
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Apollo Global Management Inc. and Blackstone Inc.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——阿波罗全球管理公司和黑石公司

title: Microsoft NHS Copilot Deal Tests Real World Healthcare AI Adoption
title_zh: Microsoft NHS Copilot 交易测试现实世界医疗保健人工智能的采用
summary: Microsoft (NasdaqGS:MSFT) has secured a landmark agreement with NHS England for Microsoft 365 Copilot. The rollout will cover 505,000 clinicians and support staff across the NHS England workforce.
summary_zh: 微软（NasdaqGS：MSFT）与英国 NHS 就 Microsoft 365 Copilot 达成了具有里程碑意义的协议。此次推出将覆盖英国 NHS 员工队伍中的 505,000 名临床医生和支持人员。

title: SpaceX lands $30 billion Google deal a week before its IPO
title_zh: SpaceX 在 IPO 前一周与谷歌达成 300 亿美元的交易
summary: Every company gets one shot to redefine what it is. Most never take it. The ones that do tend to look unrecognizable a few years later, and the market either rewards the reinvention or punishes the nerve.
summary_zh: 每家公司都有机会重新定义自己。大多数人从来不接受它。那些确实做到了的东西几年后往往会变得面目全非，而市场要么奖励重新发明，要么惩罚神经。

title: The OpenAI Cloud Deal Powering Cerebras Stock Higher
title_zh: OpenAI 云交易推动 Cerebras 股价走高
summary: Cerebras stock has plunged in the wake of its blockbuster IPO but Wall Street is backing a comeback for the AI chip company.
summary_zh: Cerebras 的股价在其轰动的 IPO 后暴跌，但华尔街支持这家人工智能芯片公司的东山再起。
